verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox is a cloud service that runs user and agent code and data, so a buyer could fairly ask about an AI-training opt-out or no-training guarantee. The evidence pack covers isolation, persistence, images, regions and pricing, but contains nothing about data-use policy or opting out of model training. MicroVM isolation and multi-agent separation are adjacent security features and are not a training-use control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
